availableCommands.name: whisper-dictation
availableCommands.description: Use when setting up local push-to-talk voice dictation on a macOS (Apple Silicon) machine with whisper.cpp — speaking into the Claude Code prompt / terminal / any app, "dictate to Claude", microphone-to-text, a hold-a-key-and-talk hotkey. Also when whisper-server fails with "failed to open model" / "failed to initialize whisper context", choosing a ggml model, keeping the model warm, wiring a Hammerspoon hotkey, or picking the push-to-talk key on a specific keyboard. Fully local; no audio leaves the machine.

availableCommands.name: goose-doc-guide
availableCommands.description: Reference goose documentation to create, configure, or explain goose-specific features like recipes, extensions, sessions, and providers. You MUST read the relevant goose docs before answering. You MUST NOT rely on training data or assumptions for any goose-specific fields, values, names, syntax, or commands.

availableCommands.name: web-search
availableCommands.description: Search the web and extract page content using DuckDuckGo (no API key required), Tavily, or SearXNG. Use whenever the task needs current information, facts not in training data, or content from a specific URL.
